entries.reason: The data ramp is one palette of eight steps (docs/kiro-design-system.md → Data ramp, pinned whole by theme/chartRamp.test.ts): a series or category takes its step by index, so the utility mapping stays complete even while only steps 1-3 are written as utilities (SocialFeed). Tailwind emits nothing for an unused utility, so the kept mappings cost no CSS.

The tone palette pairs each solid tone with its foreground, as accent, danger and warn do (docs/kiro-design-system.md → Tones lists `text-ok-fg`). Its last user, the solid green "Saved!" button, went with 7.54.00's one Saved pattern (components/SavedStatus); the next solid ok surface takes it again. Tailwind emits nothing for an unused utility.

The foreground of a solid ok surface in every theme palette, kept with --color-ok-fg (the tone palette's pair, docs/kiro-design-system.md → Tones): unused since 7.54.00's one Saved pattern retired the solid green "Saved!" button.
React Flow's own class on a handle a connection being drawn may land on (set by @xyflow/react at run time, never in our markup): the canvas styles it to grow and fill (workflowCanvas.css).
